name: Kisara
source:
The Cool Headed Vampire

Kisara is overprotective and wary of humans, but as she watches her sister slowly come out of her shell, she realizes that perhaps she needs to do some growing too.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1498282000590983169?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]official Twitter[/url]]
